target.description: Mount point where the UI component should appear. Options: 'floating' (overlay), 'story_header', 'story_segment_{id}', 'story_segment_{id}_before', 'story_footer', 'world_header', 'world_overview'

spec.description: Component specification defining the UI to render. Must include 'type' (Dialog, Button, Text, Stack) and 'props'. May include 'id' and 'children' for nested components.

action.description: Action to perform: create (new component), update (existing component), remove (delete component)
